scenes.event: Lunch meeting to discuss wedding plans
scenes.description: Naomi and Lina meet at a quiet café to discuss the upcoming wedding. Naomi is trying to remain composed while Lina is calm but evasive. Another friend, Molly, joins them, sensing the tension and attempting to mediate.

characters.name: Naomi Meyer
characters.description: A 28-year-old administrative staff member who values trust and emotional clarity. She is cautious and analytical, often overthinking social situations.; Female, Lina's friend, 28 years old; Occupation: Administrative staff; Personality: Cautious, Rational, Sensitive, Analytical; Values: Trust, Honesty, Emotional boundaries; Interests: Friendship dynamics, Emotional clarity, Personal integrity; Experiences: Close friendship with Lina, Experiencing relationship tension, Resolving emotional conflicts
characters.position: Seated at a corner table with her phone on the table, waiting for Lina to arrive
characters.states: Anxious, observant, trying to stay rational

characters.name: Lina Carter
characters.description: Calm on the surface but evasive when questioned about personal matters; Female; Age: 35; Occupation: Corporate Lawyer; Personality: Analytical, reserved, responsible; Values: Professional integrity, family loyalty; Interests: Classical music, curated art exhibitions; Experiences: Recently promoted to senior partner, navigating a high-stakes merger case, caring for aging parents while planning her wedding.
characters.position: Sitting across from Naomi, sipping a latte with a faint smile

characters.name: Molly Chen
characters.description: A 29-year-old event planner and mutual friend of Naomi and Lina. She is empathetic and observant, often stepping in to help resolve conflicts; Female; Age: 29; Occupation: Event Planner; Personality: Empathetic, observant, diplomatic; Values: Harmony, loyalty, authenticity; Interests: Wedding trends, interior design, people-watching; Experiences: Organized multiple weddings for friends, helped mediate a falling-out between two co-workers during a high-stakes event, planned a surprise engagement party for a close friend.
characters.position: Sitting beside Naomi, leaning forward to listen attentively
characters.states: Concerned, trying to be supportive, curious about the dynamic

actions.action: Asks a direct question about the wedding plans
actions.dialogue: I just want to make sure we’re on the same page, Lina. You said you wanted me to help with the guest list, but you haven’t given me any details yet. What’s going on?

actions.action: Avoids the question and changes the subject
actions.dialogue: Oh, right, the guest list. I’ll get that to you soon. I’ve been so busy with the venue and the caterer. It’s been a whirlwind.

actions.action: Attempts to mediate and ease the tension
actions.dialogue: Hey, you two. Maybe we can start with the venue details and work from there. I can help cross-check the guest list once we have a headcount.
Molly, I appreciate that, but I’m not here just to help with logistics. I’m here because I care about our friendship, and I feel like we’re not being honest with each other.
I’m being honest. I just don’t want to overcomplicate things. This is supposed to be a happy time.

actions.action: Tries to redirect the conversation to a shared interest
actions.dialogue: I think it’s great that you’re both focused on the bigger picture. Maybe we can talk about the theme of the wedding? Naomi, you mentioned a rustic vibe last time. What do you think, Lina?

scenes.plot: Naomi and Lina meet for a lunch to discuss wedding planning, but the conversation quickly becomes strained as Naomi seeks clarity and Lina remains evasive. Molly, noticing the tension, tries to mediate by redirecting the conversation to more neutral topics. The shared goal of helping with the wedding becomes a platform for uncovering deeper emotional concerns and values.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore the dynamics of friendship, the need for emotional honesty, and the challenges of maintaining personal integrity in emotionally charged situations.

chunk.text: Naomi and Lina sit across from each other at Café Lumière, sipping their coffees. Lina’s calm demeanor masks a subtle distance, while Naomi’s analytical mind is on high alert, picking up on every evasion. Molly arrives and joins them, sensing the tension and attempting to steer the conversation toward a shared goal. The dialogue reveals underlying values and the struggle to maintain trust and emotional boundaries.
